paragraphs.source_en: He could not, of course, and would not consider how ill he was. But all this continual anxiety and agony of mind could not but affect him. But this artificial excitement could not last long.

paragraphs.source_en: He wandered aimlessly. The sun was setting. A special form of misery had begun to oppress him of late.
